body: hero_status_label() composes SILENCED/ROOTED/INTANGIBLE/BURNING/UNKILLABLE tags from existing generic status fields, drawn above the name label when active. Stun/slow not modeled as fields yet, not fabricated for this UI task. Client-side only, clean build, full suite 366 checks unaffected. Commit c0eac23.
